entries.en: Papawazu would offer you another commission and a chance to admire him, if the mood strikes you.
entries.fr: Papawazu aimerait vous offrir une autre mission, si vous êtes d'accord.
entries.ja: キャンプ・ブルーフォグのパパワズは、冒険者に話があるようだ。

entries.en: The shipment of processed ceruleum will finally resume, to the satisfaction of all parties─well, except the coblyns, but creatures of their sort have no say, and dead ones doubly so. Report the news to Syntgoht at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange.
entries.fr: Les livraisons de céruleum traité vont pouvoir reprendre, pour le plaisir de tous, enfin sauf celui des coblyns. Prévenez Syntgoht à l'avenue du Saphir.
entries.ja: 「」の出荷が再開されるようだ。ウルダハのサファイアアベニュー国際市場にいる商人「シントゴート」に報告しよう。
entries.jaMacro: 「<sheet(EventItem,2000714,0)>」の出荷が再開されるようだ。ウルダハのサファイアアベニュー国際市場にいる商人「シントゴート」に報告しよう。

entries.en: Syntgoht is relieved, though vexed by the price hike. Once the goods reach him in a few days, he should in turn be able to fill his orders.
entries.fr: Syntgoht est soulagé, même s'il n'apprécie pas trop l'augmentation des prix. Une fois qu'il aura reçu la marchandise dans quelques jours, il devrait à nouveau pouvoir honorer ses commandes.
entries.ja: シントゴートに出荷再開の報告をした。が手に入れば、ただちに商品を発送できるだろう。
entries.jaMacro: シントゴートに出荷再開の報告をした。<sheet(EventItem,2000714,0)>が手に入れば、ただちに商品を発送できるだろう。

entries.en: Speak with Syntgoht at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange.
entries.fr: Parler à Syntgoht à l'avenue du Saphir
entries.ja: サファイアアベニュー国際市場のシントゴートに報告

entries.en: Anyway! The ceruleum must flow. No more delays in shipping─another brilliant coup by Papawazu! Oh, is that a feather? For my cap? Why, thank you very much!
entries.macro: <italic(1)>Any<italic(0)>way! The ceruleum must flow. No more delays in shipping─another brilliant coup by Papawazu! Oh, is that a feather? For my cap? Why, thank you very much!
entries.fr: Hum, hum... Et donc, les livraisons de céruleum vont pouvoir reprendre.

entries.en: Sooo, you can tell Syntgoht that his shipment will be there in just a few days. Unfortunately, there'll be a wee increase in price. Security surcharge, you know! Everybody does it.

entries.en: So, my dear , you're telling me they're shipping what's owed me but charging more for it. I wish Amajina and all his sons the joy of my gil. I hope it gives them gout.

entries.en: I do appreciate you sorting this out, and with that puttock Papawazu, no less. A discerning middleman such as myself will certainly remember you for future commissions!
entries.fr: Merci d'avoir réglé cette affaire. Un grossiste de mon importance n'oubliera pas ce détail pour les prochaines missions.
